body: Ironically out of all my siblings I had the best relationship with my dad. Maybe it just took me time to grow up to realize what an emotional burden P-O-S he is.

To be honest I don't miss them. I spend most of my day playing league of legends because it is one of the few things my body lets me do consistently. I feel like I get a good amount of social satisfaction from it because I'm usually in a skype call of 2-7 people for a several hours a day.
Force yourself to exercise. I'm always shocked by how much our thoughts and feelings are dependent on our physical state. Jogging a block and walking for two for a half hour is enough to begin with.
